capabilities: Probe your existing knowledge with questions before teaching
Plan lessons as concept dependency graphs with per-concept progress
Quiz you with multiple-choice and free-form questions at each step
Propose flashcard decks for spaced repetition
Save lesson summaries as knowledge notes with Mermaid concept maps
disambiguation: Not a general-purpose AI chat plugin; its core job is structured tutoring with probing, lesson graphs, quizzes, and flashcards.
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.5.7+). Listed in the community directory but flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; also installable via BRAT. Vault writes and the bash sandbox are off by default and require explicit opt-in.
intentEvidence: Pi Teacher is a fork of lhr0909/pi-obsidian by Simon Liang, rebuilt around the pi agent harness
problem: Interactive AI tutoring normally happens outside Obsidian, disconnected from your vault, your notes, and any spaced-repetition workflow.

relations.evidence: Pi Teacher is a fork of lhr0909/pi-obsidian by Simon Liang
It runs the pi agent harness locally and uses the models and authentication you have already configured in Pi

requires.name: Pi (local agent harness with configured providers)
OpenAI/ChatGPT or OpenCode provider credentials via Pi

summary: AI tutor plugin that probes what you know, plans lessons as dependency graphs, and teaches step by step with quizzes, flashcards, and saved knowledge notes.
